WIRES (DRAWING NO. · HOLE · SIGNAL · WIRE · OTHER END: ● SOLDERED, D DUPONT, XH JST-XH, F / M · TO)
TP4056 B+ pad (R2 1 MΩ in line at the pad end)
X14 → left tube → S3 IO1 [X14 br. 1]
X14 → left tube → S3 IO21 [X14 br. 2]
X14 → left tube → S3 IO36 [X14 br. 3]
R23 1 MΩ in line (heat-shrink, at this end) → X14 → left tube → carrier G8 (VSENSE_B) [X14 br. 4]
column J, rows 3–6: the harness clip (z 179) passes 4 mm above: lying parts only
Single-sided board, copper underneath: no copper under Q1 / Q5 nor under the part bodies.
Lying parts (1/4 W, 7.62 pitch), D1 lying (Ø5.3): height ≤ 6 mm. Q1 and Q5 (SOT-23) glued legs up in the drawn
orientation (seen from the top, flipped: G / S / D on the sketch), linked with insulated 30 AWG wire-wrap wire
(Kynar), stripped 2 mm at each end (one touch of the iron each); glue on top once tested.
The underside carries the GND bus (tinned wire along row 1: the ground star), the bridges and all the wires,
which leave towards the front (row 1) then go up or down in the front corridor.
Holes left empty between the power nets and ground / the GPIOs: don't fill them with solder.
Check to GND, without the modules: VUSB ≈ 9.4 kΩ (R1 ∥ R15 + R16), USB_DET ≈ 44 kΩ, VBAT/2 ≈ 1 MΩ, B+ ≈ 2 MΩ,
VPATH / VSYS / OUT+ > 1 MΩ; OUT+ ↔ VSYS and OUT+ ↔ VPATH open.
